blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.
blocks.zh: 互动世界模型将过去块的 KV 保留为检索内存,以便重新审视的地方保持一致。 在单个消费机上(1个RTX 4090,32个主机内存的GiB,1个NVMe SSD),带有这种内存的长会打出两面墙. 第一个是容量:Matrix-Game 2.0的KV在bf16的45秒视频后和int4的2.8分钟后会排出主机内存. 二是该型号的定位地平线为4.3分. 我们显示这个内存是容量约束而不是带宽约束,它的访问集在计算前是已知的,因为相机姿势是一种输入. 基于这些观测结果的分析模型预测溢出指向一块之内,在被搁置的配置上正确划分出零与非零的摊位. 在它的指导下,WorldPager将 int4 KV存储在了GPU/DRAM/NVMe的分级中,而不是重构它,预先从外推的外推姿势中检查出每个块的内存,永远不等待出错,并在后台写作;据我们所知,它是第一个将互动世界模型的KV内存放入了NVMe分级上并有"零上架"预取. 通过无训练位置处理,它以零档和恒定主机内存持续生成37.5分钟的视频,每秒约9.5帧. 在被封存的测试集上,int4存储显示没有可测量的质量损失;在长庚重访时,它将图像质量降低约一个MUSIQ点.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Interactive world models generate video chunk by chunk in response to a user’s keyboard and mouse actions [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] .
For such a world to stay consistent, a place the user returns to must look as it did before, and recent systems achieve this with retrieval memory: they keep the keys and values (KV) of past chunks and let a new chunk attend to the ones whose camera pose matches [ 4 , 5 ] .
These systems are evaluated on data-center GPUs.
We study the same workload under tight resources: one consumer GPU (an RTX 4090 with 24 GB), a 32 GiB host-memory budget, and one NVMe SSD.
The question is how long such a machine can keep generating a consistent world.
blocks.zh:
互动世界模型针对用户键盘和鼠标动作[1,2,3]逐块生成视频块.
为了保持这样一个世界的一致性,用户返回的地方必须像以前那样查看,最近的系统通过检索内存来实现这一点:它们保留过去块的键和值(KV),让新的块照顾那些相机显示匹配[4,5]的人.
这些系统在数据中心GPU上进行评估.
我们在紧缺的资源下研究同样的工作量:一个消费型GPU(一台RTX 4090,24GB),一个32 GiB主机-记忆预算,和一个NVMe SSD.
问题是这种机器能持续多久才能产生一个连贯的世界。

blocks.en:
Two walls stop it, and Fig. 1 shows both for Matrix-Game 2.0 (MG2) [ 1 ] .
The first wall is capacity .
The KV of one chunk, 0.75 s of video, occupies 486.6 MB in bf16, and retrieval memory keeps all of it.
Kept on the GPU, memory runs out at chunk 21 (16 s of video); kept in host memory, at chunk 60 (45 s); quantized to int4 and kept in host memory, at chunk 226 (2.8 minutes).
The second wall is the positional horizon : the model’s rotary position table covers 1024 latent frames, and generation fails at chunk 341 (4.3 minutes) whatever the memory system.
blocks.zh:
两面墙挡住它,图1同时为Matrix-Game 2.0(MG2)[1]显示.
第一个墙是容量。
一个块的KV,0.75 s的视频,在bf16中占据486.6 MB,检索内存保存全部.
固定在GPU上,内存耗尽在块21(16 s of video);保存在主机内存中,积分60(45 s);量化为整数4,保存在主机内存中,积分226(2.8分钟).
第二面墙是位置地平线:模型的旋转位置表包括1024个潜在框架,无论内存系统如何,生成均以341块(4.3分钟)的速度失效。

blocks.en:
Existing approaches do not remove these walls on a single consumer machine.
LLM offloading systems move KV between GPU, host memory, and disk [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] , but they are built on the premise that decoding is limited by the bandwidth of that movement, and those that load only a subset of entries must compute or speculate the access set at run time [ 7 ] .
World-model memory systems keep KV on the GPU [ 4 ] or in host memory [ 5 , 9 , 10 ] , which only moves the first wall from chunk 21 to chunk 60; WorldKV notes that transfer latency limits its CPU-offloaded variant [ 4 ] .
WorldPlay [ 3 ] keeps frames and recomputes their KV for every chunk, which costs 3.07 × \times a denoising step per retrieved chunk on our GPU.
KV quantization [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] reduces bytes per chunk by a constant factor, which delays the first wall but does not remove it.
blocks.zh:
现有方法不会在单一消费机器上拆除这些墙壁。
LLM卸载系统在GPU,主机内存,和磁盘[6,7,8]之间移动KV,但它们建立在解码受该移动带宽限制的前提上,那些只装入子集的条目必须计算或推测运行时间[7]设定的访问权限.
World-model memory systems keep KV on the GPU [4] 或者在主机内存 [5,9,10],它只将第一面墙从第21块移动到第60块;WorldKV指出,转录延迟限制了它的CPU卸载变体[4].
WorldPlay [3] 保存帧并重算每块的KV, 成本为 3. 07 ×\ 时间为我们GPU 上每个检索到的块的去Noing step 。
KV 量化 [11, 12, 13] 将每个块的字节减少一个恒定因子, 这会延迟第一个壁, 但不会移除它 。

blocks.en:
Our starting point is a characterization of this workload.
World-model memory is capacity-bound, not bandwidth-bound : a chunk takes about 1.2 s to compute, while the KV it must read fits in that window many times over, even from NVMe.
Its access set is also known before compute : the retrieval key is the camera pose, which follows from the control input.
An operating system cannot prefetch reliably because the future page-reference string is unknown; here the control input makes that string known one chunk ahead.
From these two properties we derive a first-order analytical model that predicts where each budget spills, how much bandwidth prefetching needs, and how long an on-demand design stalls, and we test it on configurations held out from its construction.
blocks.zh:
我们的出发点是描述这一工作量。
World-model memory是容量约束的,而不是带宽约束的:一个块需要大约1.2s才能计算,而KV则必须多次在窗口中读取,甚至从NVMe读取.
其访问集在计算前也为人所知 : 检索密钥是相机的姿势,由控制输入产生.
一个操作系统无法可靠地预选,因为未来的页面引用字符串是未知的;在这里,控制输入使该字符串提前知道一个块.
从这两个属性中,我们得出一个一阶分析模型, 预测每个预算溢出的地方, 多少带宽预设需求, 以及一个点播设计摊位的长度, 我们用它构建的配置进行测试。

blocks.en:
Guided by the model, we build WorldPager, a memory runtime that sits below the retrieval policy.
It stores int4 KV in a GPU / pinned-DRAM / NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk’s retrieval set from the extrapolated pose while the previous chunk is denoised, falls back to the previous set on a miss instead of waiting, and writes spilled blocks back in the background.
To cross the second wall it handles positions at inference time, without training: the position table is extended, which leaves the native horizon bit-identical, and retrieved memory is re-placed near the current frame beyond it, following established practice [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh:
在模型的指引下,我们建造了WorldPager,一个位于检索政策下的内存运行时间.
它将 int4 KV 存储在 GPU / 绑定- DRAM / NVMe 结构中, 而不是重算它, 在前一个块被解析时, 预选每个块的检索设置在外推的姿势中, 返回到之前的设定上而不是等待, 并在背景中写出溢出的块 。
为了跨越第二面墙,它在推论时处理位置,没有经过训练:位置表被延长,使得本土地平线位点相同,按照既定惯例,检索到的内存被重新放置在它以外的当前框架附近[14、15、16、3]。

blocks.en:
We make three contributions. • Two walls, characterized and modeled. We show that memory-augmented world models on a consumer machine hit a capacity wall long before a bandwidth limit, and a positional wall at the model’s native horizon. Our analytical model predicts the spill point, the bandwidth at which prefetching fails, and the stall of on-demand swap-in. On held-out configurations its eight spill-point and first-read predictions fall within one chunk, all 15 zero/non-zero stall predictions are correct, and 22 of 24 registered criteria on MG2 and int8 are met (Sec. II ). • Crossing the first wall. We store int4 KV instead of recomputing it and, to our knowledge, WorldPager is the first system to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With all retrieved KV read from NVMe, prefetching removes the 60 ms per-chunk stall of on-demand swap-in and keeps the median stall at zero down to 0.25 GB/s (Sec. III , Sec. IV-C ). • Crossing the second wall, end to end. With training-free position handling, one consumer machine generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously, instead of 45 seconds before host memory runs out (2.8 minutes with int4 alone), with zero stalls and constant host memory. Long-gap memory is read back from NVMe without stalls; int4 storage leaves revisit consistency unharmed and lowers long-gap image quality by about one MUSIQ point; on a sealed test set, int4 shows no measurable quality loss (Sec. IV-E , Sec. IV-F ). WorldPager does not make generation real-time: the 37.5 minutes of video take 63 minutes to generate (about 9.5 fps).
Sec. V reports what did not work and why, and Sec. VII lists the limits of our evidence.
blocks.zh:
- 我们作出三项贡献。 两面墙壁,特征和模型化. 我们显示,消费机上的记忆增强型世界模型早在带宽限制之前就撞上了容量墙,在模型的原生地平线上撞上了位置墙。 我们的分析模型 预测溢出点, 带宽 在其中预选失败, 和按需互换的摊位。 就搁置配置而言,其8个溢出点和首读预测都在一个块之内,所有15个零/非零摊位预测都是正确的,在24个注册的MG2和int8标准中,有22个符合(Sec.II)。 我们存储 int4 KV 而不是重置它,据我们所知,WorldPager是第一个将交互式世界模型的KV内存放置在NVMe级上,并带有0-stall预置功能的系统. 随着所有检索到的KV从NVMe读取,预选取消点播互换的每堆60ms的摊位,并将中位摊位保持在0.25GB/s(Sec. III, Sec. IV-C.). • 越过第二面墙,结束到结束。 通过无训练位置处理,一台消费机连续生成37.5分钟的视频,而不是主机内存耗尽前45秒(仅Int4就用2.8分钟),零档和恒定主机内存. 从NVMe读回长距存储器,没有摊位;int4存储机叶重温一致性而无损,并将长距图像质量降低约一个MUSIQ点;在一个密封的测试集上,int4显示没有可测量的质量损失(Sec. IV-E, Sec. IV-F.). 世界 传呼机不使生成实时:37.5分钟的视频需要63分钟才能生成(约9.5英尺).
V部长报告了什么是行不通的,为什么, 和七部长列出了我们证据的限度。

blocks.en: II Two Walls: Characterization and an Analytical Model
blocks.zh: 二. 两面墙:特点和分析模型

blocks.en: This section characterizes memory-augmented generation on our platform, identifies the two walls that bound a session, and turns the characterization into an analytical model whose predictions we test on configurations that were not used to build it.
blocks.zh: 本节描述我们平台上的内存增强的生成,识别绑定一个会话的两面墙,并将特征转换为分析模型,我们的预测测试没有用来构建的配置.

blocks.en: II-A Setting
blocks.zh: II-A 设置

blocks.en:
A chunk-wise interactive world model generates video one chunk at a time, conditioned on the user’s keyboard and mouse actions.
MG2 [ 1 ] has 1.8B parameters including its action modules; a chunk is three latent frames, or 12 video frames (0.75 s at 16 fps), and is denoised in four steps.
Attention covers an attention sink, a short local window, and, with retrieval memory, k = 3 k{=}3 earlier chunks selected by camera pose [ 4 , 5 ] .
Retrieval memory therefore keeps the KV of every generated chunk, and that KV grows linearly with session length: one chunk occupies B c = 486.6 B_{c}=486.6 MB in bf16 across the 30 layers.
Our platform is one RTX 4090 (24 GB), a 32 GiB host-memory budget, and one NVMe SSD (5.82 GB/s sequential read with O_DIRECT ; 24–25 GB/s host-to-device copies from pinned memory).
blocks.zh:
以用户键盘和鼠标动作为条件,
MG2 [1] 具有1.8B参数,包括其动作模块;块是3个潜在帧,或12个视频帧(在16英尺处为0.75秒),分4个步骤去诺.
注意范围包括一个注意槽,一个短的局部窗口,加上检索内存,由相机选择的 k = 3 k{=}3 早期块 [4, 5].
因此检索内存保留了每个生成块的KV,KV随着会话长度的线性增长:一个块占据B c = 486.6 B_{c}=486.6 BF16中的MB横跨30层.
我们的平台是一台RTX 4090(24 GB),一台32 GiB主机-记忆预算,以及一台NVMe SSD(5.82 GB/s 顺序读取 O_DIRECT;24–25 GB/s主机-device 复制件来自绑定内存).

blocks.en: II-B The first wall: capacity, not bandwidth
blocks.zh: 二级B级 第一道墙:容量,而不是带宽

blocks.en:
Memory runs out long before moving it becomes a problem.
Keeping retrieved KV on the GPU exhausts the 24 GB at chunk 21 (16 s of video). Counting allocated bytes alone gives an upper bound of 28 chunks; adding the allocator slack and non-PyTorch memory measured in the same run gives 21, which is a calibration rather than an independent prediction.
Moving it to host memory in bf16 lasts until chunk 60 (45 s), and int4 storage until chunk 226 (2.8 min); all three points come before the model’s native limit of 341 chunks.
blocks.zh:
记忆在移动之前就已经耗尽了 它成为一个问题。
在GPU上保留检索到的KV会排出第21块(16 s of video)的24GB. 仅仅计算分配的字节就给出了28块的上界;加上在同一运行中测量的分配器松动和非PyTorch内存就给出了21块,这是一个校准而不是独立的预测.
在 bf16 中移动到主机内存持续到块60(45 s),在块226(2.8 min)之前的 int4 存储;所有三个点都位于模型的原生限制341块之前.

blocks.en:
Bandwidth, by contrast, is not the constraint.
A chunk takes about 1.2 s to compute, and reading 1.46 GB (the KV of three bf16 chunks) from NVMe into pinned memory and on to the GPU takes 276 ms when the two stages are pipelined.
With one chunk of double buffering, the read is hidden completely: in a microbenchmark with the real MG2 computation and synthetic transfer payloads, the stall is 0.0 ms for 0.37 GB and 1.46 GB payloads from DRAM and from NVMe, against 15.8 to 289.1 ms when the same payloads are copied synchronously.
The working set per chunk is small compared with the compute window, while the total state grows without bound.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,Bandwidth并不是限制。
一个块大约需要1.2 s才能计算,从NVMe读出1.46 GB(3 bf16块的KV)成固定内存,到GPU,在两个阶段的管道铺设时需要276 ms.
有了一块双缓冲器,读数就被完全隐藏起来:在一个具有真实的MG2计算和合成转移有效载荷的微生物基准中,摊位为0.37 GB和1.46 GB有效载荷的0.0ms,来自DRAM和NVMe,当同一有效载荷被同步复制时为15.8至289.1ms.
每个块的工作集与计算窗口相比是小的,而总状态则无约束地增长.

blocks.en:
This is the opposite of the premise of LLM offloading.
Systems such as FlexGen [ 6 ] and InfiniGen [ 7 ] offload KV because decoding is limited by the bandwidth of moving it: a decoding step is short, so a transfer cannot hide behind it.
Table I summarizes the contrast.
We use this observation as the basis of the design; we do not claim the general observation that video diffusion is compute-heavy, which is well known.
blocks.zh:
这与LLM卸载的前提相反.
FlexGen [6] 和 InfiniGen [7] 卸载KV等系统,因为解码受移动的带宽限制:一个解码步骤很短,所以传输不能隐藏在它后面.
表一总结了对比。
我们以这一观察作为设计的基础;我们并不声称关于视频传播是计算-沉重的一般看法,这是众所周知的。

blocks.en: TABLE I: Premises of KV offloading in LLM decoding versus world-model memory (qualitative; our measurements for the right column).
blocks.zh: 表格 一:在LLM解码器中卸载KV的房地与世界模型内存(定性;我们右栏的测量)。

blocks.en: II-C The access set is known before compute
blocks.zh: 二级C级 访问集在计算前已知

blocks.en:
In LLM decoding with selective KV retrieval, the entries a step needs depend on its query, which exists only after the preceding computation; systems either select them on the critical path or speculate, as InfiniGen does by rehearsing the next layer’s attention [ 7 ] .
(Coarser look-ahead exists, for example a fixed layer order [ 6 ] or a queue of waiting requests [ 8 ] .)
In an interactive world model, the retrieval key is the camera pose, which follows from the user’s actions.
An operating system cannot prefetch reliably because the future page-reference string is unknown; here the control input makes the reference string known one chunk ahead.
In practice the next action may not be known yet, so WorldPager extrapolates the pose, and the prediction can miss.
On synthetic trajectories of four motion classes, constant-velocity extrapolation finds the retrieval set of the next chunk with a hit rate of 0.66–0.94, against 0.03–0.52 when the current pose is reused (CPU simulation, 50 trajectories of 800 chunks per class, assuming a 90° field of view).
In the end-to-end runs, the fraction of retrieved blocks that the prefetch missed is 0.010 on a_yaw and 0.020 on b1_ws, and the stale-set fallback covers these cases.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: II-D The second wall: the positional horizon
blocks.zh: 二级D级 第二面墙:位置地平线

blocks.en:
MG2 encodes time with a rotary position table of 1024 latent frames, so with the original table generation fails at chunk 341 (about 4.3 minutes of video).
This wall is independent of memory.
Removing it by recomputing memory at new positions, as WorldPlay does [ 3 ] , costs 3.07 × \times a denoising step per retrieved chunk on our GPU (Sec. III-A ); Sec. III-E handles it at inference time instead.

这座墙独立于记忆.
通过在新位置重算内存来删除它, 正如 WorldPlay 做的 [ 3], 费用为 3. 07 ×\ 计算出我们GPU( Sec. III- A )上每个检索到的块的去名步骤 ; Sec. III- E 处理它时是推断时间 。

blocks.en:
Held-out validation. We then registered predictions for configurations that were not used to build the model and ran them without adjusting the predictions (Table II ).
All eight spill-point and first-NVMe-read predictions, from four held-out configurations, fall within one chunk of the measurement: int8 storage (emulated by padding int4 content to the int8 block size, so it tests byte accounting only, not int8 quality or dequantization), a 64 GiB round trip on MG2, and LingBot-World [ 2 ] round trips of 200 and 240 chunks.
All 15 zero/non-zero stall predictions are correct, and 7 of the 9 non-zero stall magnitudes are within 30%; overall, 22 of the 24 registered criteria on MG2 and int8 are met.
On LingBot-World, 45 of 48 read-path criteria are met, and the SATA-class emulation of Sec. IV-C meets all 10.

blocks.en:
We describe three misses.
(i) On b1_ws at 0.1 GB/s, just below the predicted failure bandwidth of 0.103 GB/s, prefetching stalls 75.7 ms against a predicted 38.1 ms; near the transition the two terms of Eq. ( 2 ) nearly cancel, so small errors are amplified: a limiter that delivers about 3.7% less than its nominal rate adds about 50 ms, and a compute window about 11 ms longer than assumed removes part of it.
(ii) On LingBot-World at 0.075 GB/s the model overestimates the stall by 71% (448.5 against 262.6 ms, three repetitions), a systematic error that we attribute to the choice of T c T_{c} and to the limiter’s accounting.
(iii) On the 240-chunk LingBot-World round trip, the measured volume read back from NVMe is 26.6% below the prediction (2.20 against 3.0 GiB), because the model overestimates how many blocks are read back.
We later derived two corrections (a read-back term in the write volume and a per-chunk rather than mean read size near the failure bandwidth); they were fitted after the fact and are not validated.

Projections. Used as a design guide, the model indicates what other budgets need (values are projections unless noted).
With 64 GiB of host memory, MG2 with int4 fills the pool at chunk 492, about 10 minutes of wall-clock time, so a one-hour session still needs a storage tier of roughly 300–600 GiB. We later checked this point directly: a DRAM-only int4 run with 64 GiB, registered with a prediction of 492 (window 477–507) before it ran, stopped at chunk 496 (+0.8%). Its registered tolerance was ± \pm 3%, wider than the one-chunk criterion of the spill predictions, so it is not counted among the eight in Table II .
Prefetching needs about 0.10 GB/s of read bandwidth and write-back about 0.11 GB/s (up to 0.21 GB/s with read-back), so even a SATA SSD, whose vendor specification is about 0.5 GB/s, would suffice by bandwidth.

blocks.en: III WorldPager Design
blocks.zh: III 世界包装设计

blocks.en:
WorldPager is a memory runtime that sits below the retrieval policy of a chunk-wise world model.
The policy decides which past chunks a new chunk attends to; WorldPager decides where their keys and values live and when they move.
Each design choice follows from one term of the analytical model in Sec. II .
Fig. 2 gives the overview, and Table III maps the components to the model terms they answer.
blocks.zh:
WorldPager是一个内存运行时间,它坐落在一个块形世界模型的检索政策之下.
该政策决定了过去要处理哪些新块;WorldPager决定它们的钥匙和价值在何地生活和何时移动。
每个设计选择都遵循Sec.II中分析模型的一个术语.
图2给出了概述,表三将组件映射到它们所回答的模型术语中.

While chunk c c is denoised, the retrieval set of chunk c + 1 c{+}1 is computed from the extrapolated camera pose and staged to the GPU by a prefetch thread. A miss reuses the previous retrieval set instead of waiting. Cold dirty blocks are written to NVMe by a background thread.

blocks.en: III-A Store quantized KV instead of recomputing it
blocks.zh: III-A 存储量为 KV 而不是重算

blocks.en:
A memory system for a world model can keep either the generated latent frames or the keys and values computed from them.
WorldPlay [ 3 ] keeps frames: for every chunk it rebuilds a memory context and recomputes the memory KV from it (its Algorithm 2 resets the cache from the reconstituted context), and it reports real-time inference on eight H800 GPUs.
On our platform this choice does not fit the time budget.
Recomputing the KV of one retrieved chunk of Matrix-Game 2.0 (MG2) [ 1 ] from its clean latents, which replays the chunk and its two predecessors through all 30 layers, takes 585.5 ms on an RTX 4090, or 3.07 × \times one denoising step (190.4 ms).
A chunk retrieves three such chunks and is denoised in four steps, so recomputation would more than double the chunk time.
blocks.zh:
一个世界模型的内存系统既可以保存生成的潜在框架,也可以保存从它们中计算出来的键和值。
WorldPlay [3] 保存帧: 对于每个块,它重建一个内存上下文,并从中重新计算内存 KV(它的算法2将缓存从重组的上下文重置),它实时报告对8个H800 GPU的推论.
在我们的平台上,这种选择不符合时间预算。
重新计算从它清洁的潜伏物中提取的一块Matrix-Game 2.0 (MG2) [1] 的KV,它通过所有30层重放该块及其两个前身,在RTX 4090上需要585.5 ms,或3.07 ×\ times 1 denoning step (190.4 ms).
一个块取回3个这样的块,然后分4个步骤去命名,所以重算会比块时间多一倍以上.

blocks.en:
WorldPager therefore stores the KV.
The cost of this choice is capacity: one chunk of MG2 KV occupies 486.6 MB in bf16, which is the quantity that exhausts host memory in Sec. II .
We reduce it with standard KV quantization.
Keys are quantized per channel and values per token, following KIVI [ 11 ] ; we use symmetric int4 with groups of 64 and bf16 scales, which brings a chunk to 129.4 MB (26.6% of bf16).
Only the remote chunks that the retrieval policy may read are quantized; the attention sink, the local window, and the chunk being generated stay in bf16.
The bit width was fixed by a rule registered before the bit-width sweep: the lowest width whose revisit-retention confidence bound stays above 95% and whose image quality does not drop measurably, which selected int4 over int3 and int2 (Sec. V ).
Reading a block back costs only dequantization, 10.9 ms per chunk in the median, instead of a 585.5 ms recomputation per retrieved chunk.
Under the same 32 GB host budget, the pool holds 226 int4 chunks against 60 bf16 chunks (3.8 × \times ).
We do not claim novelty for the quantizer.
QuantWM [ 12 ] and Quant VideoGen [ 13 ] report 2-bit KV quantization for world and video models, and WorldPager can use such a quantizer unchanged; Sec. V reports what 2 bits cost on our setting.
blocks.zh:
因此WorldPager存储了KV.
这一选择的成本是容量:一块MG2 KV在bf16中占有486.6 MB,这是Sec.II中耗尽主机内存的数量.
我们用标准的KV量化法来减少它.
密钥按每个通道和每个令牌的值进行定量,按照KIVI [11];我们使用对称的整数组64和bf16比例尺,使块达到129.4 MB(占bf16的26.6%).
只有检索策略可能读取的远程块被量化;注意槽,本地窗口和生成的块停留在bf16中.
比特宽度被比特宽度扫荡前注册的一条规则所固定:最短的宽度,其重访-保留置信约束度保持在95%以上,且其图像质量不能以可估量的方式下降,它选择了int4比nt3和nt2(Sec.V.).
读取区块背面成本仅减值,中位数为每块10.9 ms,而不是每个检索区块重算585.5 ms。
在同样的32GB主机预算下,游泳池持有226英寸4块,而60 bf16块(3.8×\时)。
我们并不认为是新奇的东西
QuantWM [12] 和 Quant VideoGen [13] 报告 世界和视频模型的2位 KV 量化, WorldPager 可以使用这样的量子 不变; Sec. V 报告我们设置时2位的成本.

blocks.en: III-B A three-tier KV store
blocks.zh: III-B 一个三级KV商店

blocks.en:
The store has three tiers (Fig. 2 ).
The GPU holds the attention window and a set of staging slots for the retrieved chunks.
A pinned host-memory pool holds int4 blocks; the pool is sized to the host budget minus the process baseline and a 2 GiB margin (27.2 GiB under a 32 GB cgroup limit).
An NVMe file holds the blocks that do not fit, accessed with O_DIRECT so that NVMe traffic does not occupy the page cache, which would count against the same host budget.
The unit of storage and transfer is one block per layer and chunk (about 4.3 MB in int4), aligned to 4 KiB.
A block is written once to NVMe; a block read back from NVMe stays clean, so evicting it later costs no write.
blocks.zh:
该店有三级(图2).
GPU持有注意窗口和一组被检索块的插槽.
固定主机-记忆池持有内置4块;池的大小为主机预算减去流程基线,2 GiB比值(32 GB croup 限制下为27.2 GiB).
一个NVMe文件持有不适合的块,通过O_DIRECT访问,这样NVMe流量就不会占用页面缓存,这样会算上同一个主机预算.
存储和转让的单位是每层和块一个块(约4.3 MB int4),与4 KiB对齐.
一个块被写给NVMe一次;从NVMe读回的块保持干净,所以驱逐它以后不需要写.

blocks.en: III-C Pose-driven prefetch with a stale-set fallback
blocks.zh: 3-C Pose驱动的预选赛 与 Stale- set 后退

blocks.en:
In an interactive world model, the retrieval key of the next chunk is its camera pose, which the controller provides before the chunk is generated.
WorldPager uses the access property of Sec. II-C as follows.
While chunk c c is denoised, a prefetch thread extrapolates the camera pose of chunk c + 1 c{+}1 at constant velocity, evaluates the retrieval policy on the extrapolated pose, and stages the selected blocks from DRAM or NVMe into the GPU staging slots.
Blocks already staged for chunk c c are reused, so in steady state a chunk usually moves only the blocks that are new to its retrieval set.
When chunk c + 1 c{+}1 starts, it attends to the blocks that the policy selects at its actual pose if they are staged.
If some are not, the chunk does not wait: it reuses the retrieval set staged for chunk c c , which we call the stale-set fallback .
For example, if a revisit begins at chunk 240 and the extrapolated pose of chunk 240 misses it, chunk 240 attends to the blocks staged for chunk 239 instead of waiting for the revisited blocks.
The fallback trades a possible one-chunk delay of memory for a guarantee that generation never waits on storage; Sec. II reports the measured miss ratio.
Dequantization runs on the compute stream after staging and is not overlapped with the previous chunk.
blocks.zh:
在交互式世界模型中,下一个块的检索密钥是它的相机姿势,控制器在块产生之前提供.
WorldPager使用Sec.II-C的存取财产如下.
当块 c 被解析时,一个预切线以恒定速度推断块 c + 1 c{+}1 的相机姿势,评价在推算的姿势上的检索策略,并将选定的块从 DRAM 或 NVMe 分级到 GPU 中转槽中。
已经为 c 块布置的块被重新使用,所以在稳定状态下,一个块通常只移动其检索集的新块。
当块 c + 1 c{+}1 开始时,它会关注策略在实际位置选择的块,如果它们被设定出来的话.
如果有的不是,则块不会等待:它重新使用为块 c 预设的检索设置,我们称之为 Stale-set fall back 。
例如,如果重新审视从第240块开始,而推算出的第240块的姿势却错过了,那么第240块就处理为第239块而设的块,而不是等待重新审视的块。
倒计时交易一个可能的一卡通内存延迟,以保证世代永远不等待存储; Sec. II报告测量的误差比例.
启动后在计算流上进行减量化,不与上块重叠。

blocks.en:
Prefetching world-model memory from host memory while denoising is not new: ReWorld [ 5 ] keeps a bounded landmark bank in pinned host memory and prefetches the landmarks nearest to the current pose on a separate stream.
WorldPager differs in three respects: it selects blocks for the next chunk from an extrapolated pose, it never blocks on a miss (OmniMem [ 9 ] waits until a selected block is resident, and HERALD [ 17 ] reports a stall at block boundaries when retrieval runs late), and it extends the store to an NVMe tier with an unbounded number of chunks.
blocks.zh:
从主机内存中预选世界模型内存,而去Noising则不是新的: ReWorld [5] 将一个有界限的地标库保存在固定主机内存中,并将离当前姿势最近的地标预装在单独的溪流上.
WorldPager在三个方面有所不同:它从一个推算的姿势中为下一个块选择块,它从来不在错位上设置块(OmniMem [9] 等待一个选定的块成为居民,HERALD [17] 报告一个块边界的摊位,当检索运行较晚时,它会将商店扩展至一个无限制块数的NVMe级.

blocks.en: III-D Write path and bookkeeping
blocks.zh: III-D 写路径和簿记

blocks.en:
Once the pool is full, every new chunk must evict an old one.
Writing the victim synchronously puts an NVMe write on the critical path of every chunk (Sec. IV-D ).
WorldPager instead keeps new blocks in a dirty queue in arrival order, which approximates coldest first.
When the reclaimable space in the pool (free space, clean blocks, and blocks already queued) falls below three chunks, a background thread writes the coldest dirty blocks to NVMe with double buffering, in the same way that CachedAttention saves KV asynchronously [ 8 ] .
A block that is being written stays in the pool and is served from memory if it is read.
Allocation then evicts the least recently used clean block.
Two implementation details keep the per-chunk bookkeeping independent of session length.
Retrieval-set selection is vectorized; at chunk 2900 it takes 2.12 ms instead of 38.4 ms, with identical selections over 3000 chunks.
Victim selection uses a lazily updated heap instead of a scan over all blocks; on the return leg of a 2000-chunk round trip this reduces the median write-back time per chunk from 105.4 ms to 27.6 ms, with a bit-identical video.
blocks.zh:
一旦池子满了,每一个新块 都必须驱逐一个老块。
将 NVMe 写在每一块的临界路径上(第IV-D节)。
而WorldPager则按到达顺序将新块保留在肮脏的队列中,这大约是最冷的第一.
当池中的可回收空间(空闲空间,干净块,以及已经排队的块)落在三个块以下时,一个背景线以双缓冲方式将最冷的脏块写给NVMe,与CachedAtenty同步保存KV [8]一样.
被写入的块留在池中,如果被读取,则从内存中送达。
然后分配驱逐最近使用最少的清洁区块。
两个实施细节使每笔记账独立于会话长度.
检索设置的选择是矢量化的;在块2900时需要2.12 ms而不是38.4 ms,相同的选择超过3000块。
受害者选择使用懒散的更新堆积,而不是对所有街区进行扫描;在2000个圆形往返的返回段上,这将每块的中位回写时间从105.4毫秒减少到27.6毫秒,并带有一个比特相同的视频。

blocks.en: III-E Beyond the native horizon: inference-time position handling
blocks.zh: 三-E 超越本土地平线:推断-时间位置处理

blocks.en:
With the original position table, MG2 fails at chunk 341 (the second wall, Sec. II-D ).
WorldPager handles it at inference time and without training, in two parts.
First, it extends the position table (to 8192 rows, or 12288 for the 3000-chunk session).
Within the native horizon this changes nothing: for every chunk index below 341 the output is bit-identical to the original model.
blocks.zh:
用原来的位置表,MG2以341块(第二面墙,II-D. Sec.
WorldPager在推断时处理它,没有经过训练,分两部分.
首先,它扩展了位置表(到8192行,即3000-chunk会话的12288).
在原生的地平线内,这没有任何变化:对于341以下的每个块指数,输出与原始模型的位同.

blocks.en:
Second, beyond the native horizon, retrieved memory would sit at relative distances never seen in training.
Because the cache holds keys after rotation, WorldPager re-rotates each retrieved key by the difference between its stored position and a target position just before the window: the most recent retrieved chunk is placed 30 frames before the current chunk, older retrieved chunks and the attention sink are placed contiguously before it, and only the 44 temporal channels of each head are rotated.
Values and the window are unchanged.
The rule is hybrid: it is disabled while the chunk index is below 341, so that the first 341 chunks remain bit-identical to the model with the extended table, and it is enabled from chunk 341 on.
We verified both properties on a 24-chunk development run and a 400-chunk round trip, where the first differing chunk is chunk 341.
The re-rotation adds about 27 ms per chunk in paired round-trip runs; in the 3000-chunk session the chunk time steps up by 21.3 ms at chunk 341.
blocks.zh:
第二,超越本土视野,回收的记忆会停留在训练中从未见过的相对距离。
由于缓存在旋转后持有密钥,WorldPager通过存储位置与窗口前的目标位置的区别重新旋转每个被检索的密钥:最新的被检索块被放在当前块之前的30帧,旧的被检索块和注意力槽被连续地放在它之前,每个头的44个时间通道被旋转.
数值和窗口不变。
规则是混合的:它被禁用,而块指数则低于341,因此前341个块与扩展表的模型保持位同,并且从块341上启用.
我们在一次24吨级开发运行和400吨级的往返中验证了这两个属性,其中第一个不同的块是块341。
重新旋转在成对的往返跑道中每块增加约27 ms;在3000-chunk会话中,在341块上方的块时间步数增加了21.3 ms.

blocks.en:
Re-placing cached content at positions close to the current frame is established practice.
StreamingLLM assigns positions within the cache rather than in the original text [ 14 ] ; Rolling Forcing [ 15 ] and Deep Forcing [ 16 ] relocate the temporal positions of attention-sink frames for long video generation; and WorldPlay reassigns the positions of all retrieved context frames so that they stay close to the current frame [ 3 ] .
We do not claim the idea.
We apply it, as Rolling Forcing does, by rotating cached keys; what is specific here is only the setting: the shifted keys are pose-retrieved long-term memory that may come back from NVMe, and the shift is enabled only beyond the native horizon so that the first 341 chunks stay bit-identical.
Its effect on quality depends on the scene (Sec. V ); we treat it as an optional component that is needed only beyond 341 chunks.
blocks.zh:
将缓存内容重新放置在接近当前框架的位置是既定做法。
流转LLM在缓存中而不是在原始文本中分配位置 [14]; 滚动强制 [15] 和深度强制 [16] 为长视频生成而将注意力-沉淀帧的时间位置迁移; WorldPlay 重新分配所有已检索到的上下文帧的位置,使其保持与当前帧的接近 [3].
我们不主张这个想法。
我们通过旋转缓存的密钥来应用它,就像Rolling Forcing所做的那样;这里的特异性只是设置: 转动的密钥是可能从NVMe返回的姿势回收的长期内存,而转动只能在本地地平线之外进行,这样前341块就保持位-等位.
它对质量的影响取决于场景(Sec.V);我们将它视为一个仅需超过341块的可选组件.

blocks.en: IV Evaluation
blocks.zh: 四 评价

blocks.en:
We ask five questions.
(Q1) What does WorldPager cost per chunk while memory still fits in DRAM?
(Q2) Does prefetching keep the NVMe tier off the critical path, and how does it compare with the on-demand swap-in used by LLM serving systems?
(Q3) What does spilling to NVMe cost on the write path?
(Q4) Does a session run past both walls without stalls or memory growth, and is long-gap memory recalled from NVMe without stalls and without loss from int4 storage?
(Q5) Is quality preserved, and do the system results hold on a second model?
blocks.zh:
我们问了五个问题。
(问题1) 当内存仍然适合 DRAM 时, WorldPager 每块成本是多少 ?
(Q2) 预置是否使 NVMe 级脱离关键路径,它如何与 LLM 服务系统使用的点播互换相比?
(Q3) 向 NVMe 溢出在写入路径上的成本是什么 ?
(问题4)一个会话是否在没有摊位或内存增长的情况下贯穿两面墙壁,并且是从NVMe中恢复的长宽内存没有摊位,也没有因int4存储而丢失?
(问题5) 质量是否得到保持,系统结果是否维持在第二个模型上?

blocks.en: IV-A Setup
blocks.zh: 四A 设置

blocks.en:
Platform. One RTX 4090 (24 GB), one NVMe SSD, and a host-memory budget of 32 GiB (64 GiB where noted), enforced with a cgroup limit without swap.
NVMe accesses use O_DIRECT .
Bandwidth limits are imposed by a software token bucket on the NVMe path; they emulate slower devices and are not measurements of real ones.
blocks.zh:
平台报. 1个RTX 4090(24 GB),1个NVMe SSD,以及32个GiB(64个GiB在已注意到的地方)的主机-模拟预算,以不互换的c组限制执行.
NVMe访问器使用O_DIRECT.
Bandwidth限制是由NVMe路径上的软件符号桶施加的;它们模仿较慢的设备,而不是真实设备的测量.

blocks.en:
Model and workload. MG2 [ 1 ] (1.8B parameters including action modules) generates chunks of 12 frames (0.75 s of video at 16 fps) from keyboard and mouse actions.
The retrieval policy selects k = 3 k{=}3 past chunks by camera pose, as in WorldKV [ 4 ] .
Timing uses two synthetic trajectories with dense revisits, a yaw sweep (a_yaw) and a walk-and-strafe path (b1_ws), each 36 chunks long, plus longer round trips described where used.
Each timing configuration runs five rollouts after one discarded warm-up rollout, giving 165 steady-state chunks.
All timing comes from one starting image and one seed, and we do not report confidence intervals for it.
Host budgets are cgroup memory limits in GiB, and pinned memory counts against them.
A stall is the time a chunk waits for its retrieved KV; it excludes dequantization and write-back. We count a chunk as stalled when it waits more than 0.5 ms, and “zero stalls” means that no chunk does.
blocks.zh:
模式和工作量。 MG2 [1] (1.8B参数,包括动作模块) 从键盘和鼠标动作中生成12帧的块(视频在16 fps时为0.75 s).
检索策略按相机姿势选择 k = 3 k{=}3 过去块, 如 WorldKV [ 4] 。
Timing使用两个带有密集重访的合成轨迹,一个yaw扫描(a_yaw)和一个行走-strafe路径(b1_ws),每36块长,加上描述使用地点的更长的往返.
每个定时配置在一次丢弃的热量推出后进行五次推出,给出165个稳态块.
所有的时间都来自一个开始的图像和一个种子,我们不报告它的置信间隔.
主机预算是GiB中的croup内存限制,被绑定的内存算起它们.
一个摊位是块等待它检索到的 KV 的时间;它不包括去量化和回写。 “零摊位”意味着没有零摊位。

blocks.en:
Baselines (all are our re-implementations on the same model and retrieval policy). Sliding window : no retrieval memory. WorldKV-style : retrieved KV kept on the GPU in bf16; the official MG2 code is not public, so we reuse our implementation of its retrieval rule. ReWorld-style : all chunks in bf16 in host DRAM, prefetched one chunk ahead from the current pose, as described for ReWorld [ 5 ] , to which we add WorldPager’s stale fallback; unlike ReWorld, it neither caps the bank nor trains the model. Synchronous : retrieved chunks are copied when the chunk starts. On-demand swap-in : the synchronous copy with an LRU staging buffer on the GPU, so that a block staged for the previous chunk is reused.
It corresponds to the swap-in path of LLM serving systems that move KV on demand [ 6 , 8 ] and is the fair reference for prefetching.
blocks.zh:
基线(都是我们根据同样的模式和检索政策重新实施的基线)。 滑动窗口 : 没有检索内存 。 WorldKV-tyle : retrieved KV 保留在bf16的GPU上;官方的MG2代码不公开,因此我们重新使用执行它的检索规则. ReWorld-style : 主机 DRAM 中所有 bf16 的块, 比当前姿势提前一个块, 如 ReWorld [ 5] 所描述的, 我们添加了 WorldPager 的 stale refack; 与 ReWorld 不同的是, 它既不封顶银行也不训练模型 。 同步 : 当块开始时会复制已检索的块 。 点播互换 : 在 GPU 上使用 LRU 中转缓冲器的同步副本, 这样可以重用为上一个块设置的块 。
它对应了LLM服务系统按需移动KV[6,8]的互换路径,是前置的公平参考.

blocks.en: IV-B Per-chunk cost below the first wall (Q1)
blocks.zh: 四B类 第一层墙下方的人均成本(问题1)

blocks.en:
Table IV reports the 36-chunk runs under 32 GiB, where every method still fits.
WorldPager takes 1210.5 ms per chunk (9.91 fps) with zero stalls, against 1022.9 ms for the sliding window, which reads no memory.
At this scale the prefetching designs and synchronous int4 are within 2% of each other (the synchronous int4 copy stalls 15.8 ms per chunk); synchronous bf16 is 4.3% slower than the ReWorld-style design because of its 58.2 ms stall.
The differences that matter appear at the walls: the WorldKV-style design runs out of GPU memory at chunk 21, both bf16 host-memory designs exhaust host memory at chunk 60, and int4 without an NVMe tier at chunk 226.
blocks.zh:
表四显示,36个吨位低于32个基B,而每种方法都仍然适用。
WorldPager每块取1210.5ms(9.91英尺),零摊位,对1022. 滑动窗口9毫秒,没有读取内存.
在这个尺度上,预缩图设计和同步英寸4在相距的2%之内(同步英寸4复制档每块15.8 ms);同步bf16比ReWorld风格的设计慢4.3%,因为其58.2 ms的摊位.
在墙上出现的区别是:WorldKV风格的设计在21块时耗尽了GPU内存,同时在60块时用bf16宿主-memory设计耗尽了主机内存,在226块时用Int4没有NVMe级.

blocks.en: IV-C The NVMe tier: prefetch versus on-demand swap-in (Q2)
blocks.zh: IV-C NVMe级:预选对点播互换(问题2)

blocks.en:
To isolate the NVMe tier we force every retrieved block to come from NVMe.
Without a bandwidth limit, WorldPager takes 1255.8 ms per chunk with zero stalls on a_yaw, while on-demand swap-in stalls 60.2 ms (P50) and takes 1309.5 ms, 4.3% longer.
A synchronous copy without staging reuse stalls 111.6 ms; part of that gap comes from reuse rather than from prefetching, so we use on-demand swap-in as the reference.
b1_ws gives the same picture (0 against 61.2 ms).
blocks.zh:
为了隔离NVMe级别,我们强迫每个检索到的块都来自NVMe.
没有带宽限制,WorldPager每块需要1255.8 ms,在a_yaw上为零摊位,而点播时的换乘摊位为60.2 ms(P50),需要1309.5 ms,更长的4.3%.
一个同步的复制件,而不装配111.6 ms的重复使用; 部分空白来自重复使用,而不是前置,所以我们使用点播交换作为参考.
b1_ws给出相同的图片(0对61.2ms).

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 lowers the read bandwidth.
On a_yaw, prefetching keeps the stall at zero down to 0.25 GB/s and starts to stall at 0.1 GB/s (P50 75.9 ms), whereas on-demand swap-in stalls 116, 454, 1130, and 2256 ms at 1.0, 0.25, 0.1, and 0.05 GB/s; b1_ws gives the same values for on-demand swap-in to within 1 ms.
The transition matches the model of Sec. II : in steady state a chunk reads about one new int4 chunk, and near 0.1 GB/s that read no longer fits in the compute window.
One case must be read with care.
On b1_ws at 0.1 and 0.05 GB/s, the P99 stall of prefetching (2621 and 6490 ms) is higher than that of on-demand swap-in (2424 and 4844 ms), although its median is lower.
Below the transition bandwidth, a prefetch that has fallen behind holds the read path when a burst of new blocks is needed, and the worst chunk then waits longer than with on-demand copies.
At 0.25 GB/s this shows only in the P99 of b1_ws (399 ms against a median of 0.03 ms), and it does not occur on a_yaw.
WorldPager therefore targets the regime above the transition bandwidth, which an NVMe drive exceeds by a wide margin.
blocks.zh:
图3降低了读取带宽.
在 a_yaw 上,预置将摊位维持在 0 下至 0.25 GB/s ,并开始拖到 0.1 GB/s (P50 75.9 ms) , 而点播时的换乘摊位则在 116, 454, 1130 和 2256 ms 上以 1.0, 0.25, 0.1, 和 0.05 GB/s ; b1_ws 给1 ms 以内点播时的换乘值相同.
转换与 Sec. II 的模型相匹配 : 在稳定状态下,一个块读取大约一个新的 int4 块, 在计算窗口中读取的接近 0.1 GB/s 不再适合 。
一个案例必须仔细阅读。
在0.1和0.05 GB/s的b1_ws上,预扣的P99摊位(2621和6490ms)高于点播互换(2424和4844ms),尽管其中位数较低.
在过渡带宽下方,当需要新块爆发时,一个落在后面的预告会保留读取路径,最糟糕的块会比点播副本等待更长.
在0.25 GB/s时,这只显示在b1_ws的P99中(399 ms对中位数为0.03 ms),在a_yaw上不发生.
因此,WorldPager针对的是过渡带宽上方的系统,NVMe驱动器超过这个带宽的宽度.

SATA-class bandwidth. We emulate a SATA-class drive by limiting both reads and writes to 0.5 GB/s with a software token bucket that allows bursts of up to 16 MiB, and run a 2000-chunk round trip twice.
All ten registered predictions hold: no chunk stalls (the longest wait is 0.08 ms), no write falls back to the synchronous path, the first NVMe write and read occur at chunks 228 and 1114 as in the unlimited run, and the median chunk time (1227.8 and 1226.3 ms) stays within 0.1% of the unlimited run (1226.7 ms).
This is an emulation with a software limiter, not a measurement on a SATA drive; the SATA projection in Sec. II-E uses vendor specifications.
blocks.zh:
SATA级带宽. 我们模仿一个SATA级的驱动方式,将读写限制在0.5 GB/s,并使用一个软件符号桶,允许连续16个米B,并两次进行2000个满贯的往返。
所有十种注册预测都持有:没有块摊位(最长的等待是0.08 ms),没有书写回同步路径,第一次NVMe写和读作发生于块228和块1114,和无限跑时一样,中间块时间(1227.8和1226.3 ms)停留在无限跑时的0.1%以内(1226.7 ms).
这是一个软件限制器的仿真,而不是对SATA驱动器的测量;Sec. II-E中的SATA投影使用供应商规格.

blocks.en: IV-D Cost of spilling to NVMe (Q3)
blocks.zh: 四D级 向NVMe溢出的费用(问题3)

blocks.en:
Table V measures a 256-chunk run under 32 GiB in three intervals.
Once the pool is full (the 225–240 interval in Table V ), writing each evicted block synchronously adds 102.0 ms to every chunk, and 135.8 ms on the return leg, where reads and writes overlap.

blocks.en:
Continuous generation past both walls. Fig. 4 shows one 3000-chunk session under 32 GiB with all components enabled: int4 tiers, prefetching, background write-back, vectorized selection, the heap-based write path, and the hybrid position rule.
It produces 37.5 minutes of video in 63.2 minutes of wall-clock time (about 9.5 fps over the session and 9.7 fps at the median chunk time, below the 16 fps playback rate; WorldPager does not make MG2 real-time).
The median chunk time is 1236.4 ms (P99 1251.2 ms), the longest stall is 0.12 ms, and no chunk stalls for more than 0.5 ms.
Host memory peaks at 30.7 GiB, inside the 32 GiB budget, and does not grow, while 334 GiB are written to NVMe.
The chunk time steps up by 21.3 ms at chunk 341, where the position re-mapping turns on (Sec. III-E ), and is flat afterwards: the median of chunks 341–840 is 1237.4 ms and that of the last 500 chunks is 1238.6 ms.
This trajectory never returns to a spilled chunk, so the session exercises only the write path; reads from NVMe are measured next.

blocks.en:
Reading long-gap memory from NVMe. We run 2000-chunk round trips that walk out for 1000 chunks and return along the same path, so the return leg revisits chunks generated 21 to 1981 chunks earlier, most of them read from NVMe.
On MG2 in three scenes, no chunk that read from NVMe stalled for more than 0.5 ms (1297 such chunks in the first scene and 648 in each of the others; the longest stall was 0.21 ms), and every retrieved block was prefetched in time.
On LingBot-World [ 2 ] with round trips of 200 and 240 chunks (three repetitions each), every retrieval was a prefetch hit and the longest wait was 0.131 ms.
blocks.zh:
从 NVMe 读取长差距内存 。 我们运行2000个圆形的圆形旅行,走出1000块,沿着同样的路径返回,所以返回的腿重温了21到1981年产生的块,其中大部分是从NVMe读来的.
在三幕的MG2上,没有从NVMe读取的块搁浅超过0.5 ms(第一幕中1297个这样的块,其他各有648个;最长的摊位是0.21 ms),每个检索到的块都会在时间上被预留.
在LingBot-World [2] 上,往返200和240块(每块3次重复),每次检索都是前置命中,最长的等待时间是0.131毫秒.

blocks.en:
Does int4 tiered storage hurt long-gap recall? We compare WorldPager with the same system storing bf16 instead of int4 on 600-chunk round trips, with revisit gaps grouped as short ( < < 100 chunks), mid (100–300), and long ( > > 300).
We use three scenes, five seeds, and 13 revisit events per scene and gap tier; beyond chunk 341 both arms use the same position rule.
Table VI reports paired differences (int4 minus bf16) of two quantities: the LPIPS between a revisit frame and its first-visit frame, which measures consistency, and the MUSIQ score of the revisit frame, which measures image quality.
Consistency is not harmed: the LPIPS difference is − - 0.022 [ − - 0.037, − - 0.008] in the mid tier and − - 0.026 [ − - 0.043, − - 0.009] in the long tier; when seed variance is included, the mid-tier interval reaches zero.
Image quality on long gaps is about one point lower: the MUSIQ difference is − - 1.28 [ − - 2.25, − - 0.36] in the long tier and − - 0.67 [ − - 1.59, +0.17] in the mid tier.
Both differences stay within the tolerance registered before the runs ( | Δ | ≤ 2 |\Delta|\leq 2 ).
A lower LPIPS together with a lower MUSIQ is the direction of the copy effect discussed in Sec. V , so we do not read the LPIPS difference as an improvement.
blocks.zh:
Int4分层存储会伤害长距记忆吗? 我们比较了WorldPager与同一系统在600吨往返中储存bf16而不是整数4,重新审视的缺口分为短( < 100块)、中(100-300块)和长( > 300块)。
我们使用三个场景,五个种子,每个场景和空隙层13次重访事件;在341块之外,两种武器都使用相同的位置规则。
表六报告将两种数量的差异(int4减去bf16)进行了配对:重新审视的框架与其第一次访问的框架之间的LPIPS,衡量一致性;重新审视的框架的MUSIQ分数,衡量图像质量。
一致性不受影响:LPIPS差值为−- 0.022 [−- 0.037,−-0.08] 中层为− 0.026 [− 0.043,−-0.09] 长层为−;如果计入种子差异,中层间隔为零.

两种差异都保留在运行前的容忍度之内(XQ QQ QQ 2 Delta|\leq 2 )。
一个较低的LPIPS和一个较低的MUSIQ是 Sec. V 中讨论的复制效果的方向,所以我们不把LPIPS的区别看成是一种改进.

Five of the 15 scene–seed runs met the registered drift criterion (the two arms already differed by more than two MUSIQ points before the first revisit); excluding them gives a long-tier MUSIQ difference of − - 0.97 [ − - 1.76, − - 0.17].
In scene 0003, which has no drifting run, all five seeds show a lower long-tier MUSIQ ( − - 1.07 [ − - 1.70, − - 0.45]).
Scene 0000 keeps only two seeds after the exclusion, so its per-scene numbers are weak.
Per-scene and per-seed values are listed in Appendix A .

blocks.en: IV-F Quality and a second model (Q5)
blocks.zh: IV-F 质量和第二种模式(问题5)

blocks.en:
Sealed test set. To keep method development from leaking into the quality claim, we froze a test set of four new scenes and two trajectories (eight units, seeds 5–9) and evaluated the final configuration on it once.
We measure the fraction of the revisit benefit of full-precision memory that is retained, ( L sw − L x ) / ( L sw − L bf16 ) (L_{\mathrm{sw}}-L_{x})/(L_{\mathrm{sw}}-L_{\mathrm{bf16}}) , where L L is the revisit LPIPS and sw is the sliding window.
With int4 storage, retention is 105% [104%, 106%] and MUSIQ changes by − - 0.06 [ − - 0.19, +0.07].
Retention slightly above 100% is the direction of the copy effect (Sec. V ), not better memory, and the MUSIQ interval includes zero; we therefore find no measurable quality loss from int4 on this set.
blocks.zh:
封存测试集. 为了防止方法开发泄露到质量索赔中,我们冻结了一套由四个新场景和两个轨迹(8个单元,种子5-9)组成的测试集,并评估了其中的最后配置一次。
我们测量了保留的全部精度内存的重温收益的一小部分,(L sw − L x ) /(L sw − L bf16) (L_{\mathrm{sw}}-L_{x}) /(L_{\mathrm{sw}}-L_{\mathrm{bf16}}),其中L L是重温LPIPS,Sw是滑动窗口.
内存4,保留量为105%[104%,106%],MUSIQ变化为−-0.06[−−-0.19,+0.07].
保留略高于100%是复制效果(Sec. V)的方向,不是更好的内存,MUSIQ间隔包括0;因此在本集中我们发现int4没有可测量的质量损失.

blocks.en:
Second model. LingBot-World [ 2 ] (1.3B variant; licensed CC BY-NC-SA) was not trained with retrieval memory, and in our tests retrieval did not improve its revisit consistency, so we report system metrics only (Table VII ).
Its chunk length differs from that of MG2; one chunk of its KV is 281.7 MiB in int4.
Under 32 and 64 GiB the first NVMe write occurs at chunks 102 and 218, and the same pool holds about 3.8 × \times more int4 than bf16 chunks.
With prefetching, all 750 retrievals are hits and no chunk waits more than 0.131 ms across both repetitions (the table shows the first).
With on-demand swap-in, every chunk with retrieval waits: 37.7 ms at the median and up to 375 ms.
Retrieval itself makes a chunk 35.5% slower than the sliding window, because attention covers 12 more frames.

第二型号. LingBot-World [2](1.3B变体;许可的CC BY-NC-SA)没有接受检索内存的培训,在我们测试中检索没有提高它的重访一致性,因此我们只报告系统测量(表七).
其块长度与MG2不同;其KV的一个块为281.7 MiB int4.
在32和64 GiB下,第一个NVMe的写法发生在第102和218块,同一个池里持有约3.8×\时间比bf16块多。
由于预留,所有750个检索都是命中数,没有块在两次重复中等待超过0.131毫秒(表格显示第一个).
通过点播互换,每块有检索等待:中位数37.7毫秒,最多375毫秒.
检索本身使块比滑动窗口慢35.5%,因为注意力覆盖了另外12帧.

blocks.en: V Analysis and Findings
blocks.zh: 五. 分析和调查结果

blocks.en:
This section reports findings that shaped the design, including approaches that did not work.
Quality numbers here come from a development set of six scenes and two trajectories (12 units, seeds 5–9) on which we tuned methods, so they are weaker evidence than the sealed set of Sec. IV-F .
Retention is defined as in Sec. IV-F .
blocks.zh:
本节报告影响设计的结果,包括行不通的办法。
这里的质量数字来自一套由六个场景和两个轨迹组成的开发集(12个单元,种子5–9),我们用它们来调制方法,因此它们比密封的一套塞克(Sec. IV-F)更弱的证据.
保留的定义为四-F节。

blocks.en:
At equal bytes, quantization beats head sparsity. Before settling on int4, we stored KV only for a subset of attention heads, a natural idea because heads differ in how much they attend to distant context.
At about a quarter of the bytes, keeping all heads in int4 (26.6% of bf16) retains 105% [102%, 108%] of the memory benefit, while keeping 25% of the heads in bf16 retains 56% [51%, 61%], a difference of 48.1 points [41.0, 55.3] that holds in all 12 units.
Choosing the heads by an online ranking does not help (58%), even though head rankings are stable across scenes and events; a random half of the heads in int4 (13.3% of the bytes) retains 70%.
Fidelity is better spent on every head at lower precision than on a few heads at full precision.
blocks.zh:
在等位字节时,量化会击败头部痉挛. 在安顿在int4之前,我们只储存了KV, 仅用于一个子集的注意力头, 一个自然的想法,因为头在他们关注的远处上下文的程度不同。
在大约四分之一的字节中,将所有头保留在整数4中(bf16的26.6%)保留了105%[102%,108%]的内存福利,而bf16中保留25%的头保留了56%[51%,61%],差额为48.1分[41.0,55.3],在所有12个单元中都保留.
通过在线排名来选择头部没有帮助(58%),尽管头部排名在场景和事件上都稳定;在int4(13.3%的字节)中随机抽出一半头部保留了70%.
菲德尔在每一个头上花的精度比在几个头上花的精度要低。

blocks.en:
Memory value concentrates on revisits. If heads are restored only when a revisit is predicted, retention with a random 25% of heads rises from 56% to 81%.
Most of the benefit of memory is realized on the few chunks that return to a known place.
We tried to exploit this by reading remote memory only when a revisit is predicted.
It preserved 82% [78%, 86%] of the benefit on pose-matched revisits but raised throughput by only 1.6–3.9% on our trajectories, because the staging reuse of Sec. III-C already moves only about one chunk per step; we did not adopt it.
Its trigger also fires more often than needed on long pure rotations, because it normalizes the pose distance by the largest distance in the candidate pool.
blocks.zh:
记忆值集中于重访. 如果只有在预测重访时才恢复头部,随机保留25%的头部从56%上升到81%.
记忆的大部分好处都是在返回已知地点的少数块上实现的.
我们试图通过读取远程记忆来利用这一点,直到人们预测要重温的时候。
它保留了82% [78%,86%] 的假面重访好处,但在我们的轨迹上却只提高了1.6-3.9%的吞吐量,因为三甲的重用已经每步只动了大约1块;我们没有采纳它。
它的触发点在长时间的纯旋转上也比需要的更频繁地点燃,因为它使候选人池中最大距离的姿势距离正常化.

blocks.en:
Bit width and the copy effect. Below 4 bits, revisit LPIPS keeps falling while image quality drops: int3 retains 128% with a MUSIQ change of − - 0.90 [ − - 1.50, − - 0.32], and symmetric int2 retains 120% with − - 4.05 [ − - 6.44, − - 2.01].
Retention above 100% does not mean better memory.
Coarser keys and values make the revisited frame copy its first visit more closely, which lowers LPIPS, while texture quality degrades.
Revisit LPIPS must therefore be read together with a quality score; this is why Sec. IV-E reports LPIPS and MUSIQ side by side.
Correcting the attention bias of quantized keys [ 18 ] restores 2-bit quality on our development set (asymmetric int2 with the correction: 17.2% of the bytes, 102% retention, MUSIQ + + 0.30), but in our implementation it lengthens attention by 63–124% in microbenchmarks on synthetic tensors.
WorldPager is agnostic to the bit width; int4 is the default, and corrected int2 is an optional higher-compression setting.
blocks.zh:
位宽和复制效果 。 4位以下,在图像质量下降时重新审视LPIPS持续下降: int3保留128%,MUSIQ变化为−-0.90 [−1.50,−-0.32],对称的英寸2保留了-120% 与−4.05 [−-6.44,−-2.01].
100%以上的保留并不意味着更好的内存.
 Coarser 键和值使重新审视的帧复制其第一次访问更紧密,降低了LPIPS,同时纹理质量下降.
因此,重访LPIPS必须与质量分数一并阅读;这就是为什么Sec. IV-E同时报告LPIPS和MUSIQ.
校正量化键的注意力偏差 [18] 恢复了我们开发组的2位质量(非对称英寸2 与校正:17.2%的字节,102%的留存量,MUSIQ + + 0.30),但在我们的执行中,它延长了人工合成载荷上63-124 %的微观基准的注意力.
WorldPager对比特宽度是不可知的;int4是默认值,更正后的int2是可选的更高压缩设置.

blocks.en:
The model’s own memory weakens with distance, and the benefit of position re-mapping depends on the scene. In the 2000-chunk round trips of Sec. IV-E , we measure the fraction of the sliding window’s revisit inconsistency that memory removes, ρ = 1 − L x / L sw \rho=1-L_{x}/L_{\mathrm{sw}} , for short (21–93 chunks), mid, and long (1021–1981 chunks) revisit gaps.
In scene 0000 (two seeds), the long-to-short ratio of ρ \rho is 0.96 [0.76, 1.15] with the extended position table alone and 0.86 [0.76, 0.97] with re-mapping; in scene 0003 (one seed) it is 0.73 and 0.78.
In scene 0011 the sliding window itself barely changes on revisits (LPIPS 0.05 on short gaps), so ρ \rho is undefined in practice and we report absolute LPIPS instead: 0.338, 0.311, and 0.360 without re-mapping and 0.271, 0.270, and 0.314 with it for short, mid, and long gaps.
Gap and position in the session are confounded on these trajectories, because long gaps occur late in the return leg.
blocks.zh:
模型本身的记忆随着距离而减弱,位置重新映射的好处取决于场景. 在2000–chunk Sec. IV-E的回合中,我们测量了滑动窗口重温内存所消除的不一致部分, ^ = 1 - L x / L sw\rho= 1-L_{x}/L_{\mathrm{sw}}, 短(21–93块), 中段和长(1021–1981块)重温差距。
在场景000(两个种子)中,^rho的长对短比为0.96 [0.76, 1.15],仅延长位置表,0.86 [0.76, 0.97] 重映;在场景0003(一个种子)是0.73和0.78.
在0011场景中,滑动窗口本身在重访时几乎没有变化(LPIPS 0.05 on short difference),所以在实际操作中没有定义 $\rho,我们报告绝对的LPIPS:0.338,0.311,和0.360,没有重新映射,0.271,0.270,0.314,有短,中,长的空白.
在会话中的缺口和位置对这些轨迹都感到困惑,因为长的缺口在返回段出现较晚.

blocks.en:
In paired comparisons with one seed per scene (unlike the two-seed ratio above), re-mapping lowers revisit LPIPS by 0.15–0.28 in scene 0000 at all gaps and by 0.04–0.07 in scene 0011 at short and mid gaps (its long-gap interval includes zero), and has no measurable effect in scene 0003.
Placing retrieved memory too close (6 frames before the current chunk) or too far (96 frames) is worse than our setting of 30 frames.
We therefore treat re-mapping as an optional component whose benefit depends on the scene.
blocks.zh:
在与每个场景一个种子进行配对比较(不同于上方的双种子比例)时,重新映射会降低LPIPS的重访次数,在0-0场景中每场间隔0.15–0.28次,在0-04–0.07场景中每场间隔0.011次(其长距间隔包括0次),在0003场景中没有可测量的效果.
将已检索的内存放置得太近( 在当前块之前6帧) 或太远( 96帧) 比我们设定的30帧要差 。
因此,我们把重新绘图视为一个可选的组成部分,其好处取决于现场。

blocks.en:
Long-range texture drift is not caused by quantization. In long sessions, generation with retrieval memory develops a repeated diagonal texture after about 100 chunks.
A control that stores bf16 instead of int4 on the same trajectory and noise shows the same texture: over chunks 100–599 the texture energy ratio is 0.97 and the MUSIQ difference is − - 0.11.
The sliding window does not show this texture, but its frames leave the style of the starting image, so it is not a clean reference.
We attribute the drift to memory-conditioned generation itself, not to the precision of the stored KV.
blocks.zh:
长程纹理漂移不是由定量引起的. 在长会话中,带有检索内存的生成在大约100块后会发展出重复的对角纹理.
将 bf16 而不是 int4 存储在同一轨迹和噪音上的控制显示相同的纹理:超过块 100–599 纹理能量比为 0.97, MUSIQ 差值为− - 0.11.
滑动窗口不显示这种纹理,但其框架留下了起始图像的样式,因此它不是一个干净的参考.
我们把漂移归因于内存条件的生成本身,而不是存储的KV的精度.

blocks.en: VI Related Work
blocks.zh: 六. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Memory for interactive world models. Retrieval memory keeps world-model generations consistent on revisits.
WorldKV [ 4 ] retrieves evicted KV chunks by camera pose or action without training and keeps them in GPU or CPU memory; its authors note that host-to-device transfer latency limits the CPU-offloaded variant.
ReWorld [ 5 ] trains a model with a bounded bank of landmark chunks held in pinned host memory and prefetches the landmarks nearest to the current pose on a separate stream, overlapped with denoising.
OmniMem [ 9 ] retrieves history per attention head for long video generation, keeps a small LRU cache on the GPU, and waits for blocks that must be reloaded from pinned host memory.
WorldTrace [ 19 ] keeps evicted keys in host memory and makes memory addressable beyond the native context without training.
WorldPlay [ 3 ] retrieves past frames by field-of-view overlap and camera distance, reassigns their temporal positions, and recomputes the memory KV for every chunk.
Velox [ 20 ] reduces attention compute over resident KV with geometric routing and keeps KV on the GPU.
Inferix [ 10 ] , an inference engine for world simulation, supports offloading KV to main memory.
These works decide what a chunk should attend to, and some move memory to host DRAM; WorldPager decides where that memory lives and when it moves, and can run below any pose-keyed retrieval policy.
To our knowledge, none of them places world-model KV on an NVMe tier; Table VIII summarizes these systems.
Velox-style routing and WorldKV-style token compression reduce compute or bytes per chunk and could be combined with WorldPager; we have not tested such combinations.
blocks.zh:
互动世界模型的记忆. 检索记忆使世界模范一代在重访时保持一致.
WorldKV [4] 以相机姿势或动作检索被拆卸的KV块,而不经过训练,并将其保存在GPU或CPU内存中;其作者注意到主机到设备传输间隔限制了CPU卸载的变体.
ReWorld [5] 训练一个有捆绑的地标块库的模型,这些块被固定在主机内存中,并且预先将离当前姿势最近的地标放在一个单独的溪流上,与去诺音重叠.
OmniMem [9] 为长视频生成检索每个关注头的历史,在GPU上保留一个小的LRU缓存,并等待必须从被绑定的主机内存中重新加载的块.
WorldTrace [19] 在主机内存中保留了被拆卸的密钥,使内存在本地背景之外可以不受训练地进行地址处理.
WorldPlay [3] 以视野重叠和相机距离检索过去帧,重新指定其时间位置,并重新计算每个块的内存 KV.
Velox [20] 减少对常住KV的注意力计算,带有几何路由,并保持KV在GPU上.
Inferix [10],一种用于世界模拟的推论引擎,支持将KV卸载到主内存.
这些作品决定一个块应该注意什么,有些移动内存以主机DRAM;WorldPager决定了内存的住址和移动时间,并且可以运行在任何假键检索政策之下.
据我们所知,它们中没有一个将世界模式KV置于NVMe一级;表八概述了这些系统。
Velox风格的路由和WorldKV风格的符号压缩每块减少计算或字节,可以与WorldPager结合;我们还没有测试过这种组合.

blocks.en:
KV quantization for video and world models. KIVI [ 11 ] quantizes keys per channel and values per token.
QuantWM [ 12 ] , Quant VideoGen [ 13 ] , and TempoKV [ 21 ] quantize the KV of video and world models to 2–5 bits, and Tuncer et al. [ 18 ] correct the attention bias of quantized keys.
These methods reduce bytes per chunk by a constant factor and thus delay the capacity wall; WorldPager uses a KIVI-style int4 quantizer as a component and adds the tiers and prefetching that handle what still does not fit.
blocks.zh:
KV量化用于视频和世界模型. KIVI [11] 将每个通道的密钥和每个令牌的值量化.
QuantWM [12], Quant VideoGen [13], 和 TempoKV [21] 将视频和世界模型的 KV 量化为 2–5 比特, Tuncer 等人. [18] 纠正量化键的注意力偏差.
这些方法将每块的字节减少一个恒定因子,从而延缓容量墙;WorldPager使用一个KIVI风格的Int4四进制器作为组件,并添加了处理仍然不适配位的阶梯和前置.

blocks.en:
KV offloading and tiering for LLMs. vLLM [ 22 ] manages KV memory in pages and can swap it to CPU memory.
FlexGen [ 6 ] offloads weights and KV across GPU, CPU, and disk for throughput-oriented batch inference on one GPU, with I/O overlapped with compute in a fixed schedule.
InfiniGen [ 7 ] speculates which KV entries the next layer needs and prefetches them from CPU memory.
CachedAttention [ 8 ] caches conversation KV in host memory and disk, preloads it layer by layer, saves it asynchronously, and decouples positional encoding from cached KV.
PowerInfer [ 23 ] serves LLMs on a consumer-grade GPU.
Quest [ 24 ] shows that which KV entries matter depends on the query.
The LLM setting differs from ours in two ways that change the design: a decoding step is short, so moving KV is bandwidth-bound, and a selective access set is known only after the query is computed.
In a world model a chunk computes for about a second and its access set follows from the camera pose, which makes zero-stall prefetching from NVMe possible on a consumer machine.
blocks.zh:
KV卸载和分级为LLMs. vLLM [22] 在页面中管理KV内存,并可以将其交换到CPU内存.
FlexGen [6] 卸载重量和KV 跨越GPU,CPU,和磁盘,用于在一个GPU上进行面向吞吐量的批量推论,I/O在固定时间表中与计算重叠.
InfiniGen [7] 推测下一层需要哪个 KV 输入,并从 CPU 内存中预选.
CachedAtthy [8] 缓存在主机内存和磁盘中的对话 KV,逐层预装,同步保存,并从缓存的 KV 中解码位置编码.
Power Infer [23] 在消费级GPU上服务LLMs.
查询 [24] 显示哪些 KV 条目重要取决于查询.
LLM设置在两种方式上与我们不同,可以改变设计:解码步骤很短,所以移动的KV是带宽的,只有在计算了查询后才知道有选择性的访问集.
在一个世界模型中,一个大约一秒钟的块计算,其访问集从相机的姿势中走出来,这使得从NVMe的零架预置可以在消费机上进行.

blocks.en:
Long video beyond the native horizon. StreamingLLM [ 14 ] keeps attention-sink tokens and assigns positions within the cache.
Rolling Forcing [ 15 ] re-applies RoPE to cached keys at effective indices so that they keep a fixed relative position to the frames being denoised, and Deep Forcing [ 16 ] shifts the temporal RoPE phase of sink tokens to the current timeline.
WorldPlay applies a related reframing to retrieved memory in an interactive world model.
WorldPager’s position handling follows this practice; we apply it to pose-retrieved long-term memory that may be read back from NVMe and enable it only beyond the native horizon, so that the first 341 chunks stay bit-identical.
blocks.zh:
超越本土视野的长视频. 流式LLM [14] 保留注意力沉淀符,并在缓存内分配位置.
rolling Forcing [15] 重新应用 RoPE在有效指数下缓存密钥,使其与被取消的帧保持固定的相对位置,Deep Forcing [16] 将沉淀符的时空RoPE阶段转移至当前时间段.
WorldPlay在交互式世界模型中应用了相关的重塑来检索内存.
WorldPager的定位处理遵循了这个惯例;我们把它应用到可以从NVMe读回的外形长期记忆中,并且只能让它超越本土视野,这样前341块就保持位元不变.

blocks.en: VII Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 限制和结论

blocks.en: Limitations. Our evidence has the following scope. • One machine, one drive. All timing comes from one RTX 4090 with one NVMe SSD; slower drives are emulated with a software token bucket, including the SATA-class case. • One scene and one seed for timing. System measurements use one starting image and one seed per configuration (with up to five rollouts), so we do not report confidence intervals for them. • Quality on one model. Image-quality and consistency results are for MG2 only; on LingBot-World retrieval did not improve consistency, so we report system metrics only for it. • Long-gap image quality. int4 tiered storage lowers MUSIQ on long-gap revisits by about one point ( − - 1.28 [ − - 2.25, − - 0.36]), within the registered tolerance; scene 0000 keeps only two seeds after drifting runs are excluded. • Long-range texture drift. Memory-conditioned generation develops a repeated texture after about 100 chunks, independently of KV precision (Sec. V ). • Model accuracy. Three held-out predictions miss (near the failure bandwidth, LingBot at 0.075 GB/s, and LingBot read-back volume), and int8 was emulated by byte accounting only. • Speed. At about 9.5 frames per second, WorldPager generates video continuously but not in real time.

blocks.en:
Conclusion. On a single consumer machine, long sessions of a memory-augmented world model stop at two walls: host memory runs out after 45 seconds of video, and the model’s positions run out after 4.3 minutes.
The memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound, and its access set is known before compute, so an analytical model can predict where each budget spills and what bandwidth prefetching needs.
WorldPager follows that model: it stores int4 KV in a GPU, DRAM, and NVMe hierarchy, prefetches from the extrapolated pose without ever waiting, writes back in the background, and handles positions at inference time.
One RTX 4090 with 32 GiB of host memory and one NVMe drive then generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously, with zero stalls and constant host memory.
blocks.zh:
结论。 在一个单一的消费机器上,一个记忆增强的世界模型的长会停止在两面墙上:主机记忆在45秒的视频后耗尽,模型的位置在4.3分钟后耗尽.
内存是容量约束而不是带宽约束,其访问集在计算前就知道了,因此一个分析模型可以预测每个预算溢出的地方以及带宽预留的需求.
WorldPager遵循这个模式:它将int4 KV存储在GPU,DRAM,和NVMe的分级中,从推算的姿势中预选,永远不等待,在背景中写回,并在推算时处理位置.
1台RTX 4090装有32个主机内存的GiB和1台NVMe驱动器,然后连续生成37.5分钟的视频,零档和恒定主机内存.
